security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost https://www.youtube.com; img-src 'self' data: https://i.ytimg.com https://yt3.ggpht.com https://yt3.googleusercontent.com; script-src 'self' https://www.youtube.com; style-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.youtube.com https://www.youtube-nocookie.com; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.longDescription: ANON Alpha is a local-first Windows client for YouTube search, channel browsing, and official privacy-enhanced playback without an ANON account or ANON telemetry.
